title: Document branch-scoped IDs and a dedicated history worktree
description: Update README usage/storage guidance for both wtp-{8hex}-NNNN and legacy wtp-NNNN IDs, the exact SHA-256/first-8-lowercase-hex branch algorithm, all-named-branch coverage, detached/non-Git fallback, current-before-legacy automatic claiming, foreign exclusion, explicit start, branch rename behavior, and no automatic migration. Fix quick-start examples so users use the ID returned by task create. Add a copy-paste separate-storage recipe that creates a dedicated task-history branch checked out as an ignored worktree inside a sandbox-visible project path, points a relative .wtp.json wtpDir at it, and explains commit/sync, single-checkout/concurrent-writer, backup, and configuration-does-not-move-data cautions.
